referenceFunction.generalComment: The exchanges of the ship manufacturing are derived from an assessment of a spip, with a load capacity of 100'000t. referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This inventory calls processes of material production, representing the material composition of an average water vehicle used for solid goods transportation. For manufacturing, electricity and heavy oil burned in industrial furnace are included. For the transportation of materials standandard distance are applied. Also, waste treatment processes for non metal components of a water vehicle are accounted for.
